title: OPA Policy Decision Output
description: JSON Schema for the policy_decision value returned by OPA (POST /v1/data/data_governance/policy_decision). This is compiled and produced by data_governance.risk.rules.rego, not authored policy input, so it is deliberately separate from policy.schema.json and opa_input.schema.json. Same field set as a rule's rule_decision (policy.schema.json#/$defs/ruleDecision) plus triggered_rules and rule_combining_mode. Enum value/object definitions are shared with policy.schema.json via $ref so the two schemas stay in sync.
